_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: a Dreamcast project is one disc. A .gdi names its tracks in a sibling file, so the wizard takes the index and the frontend mounts what it references.

slots.title: Disc
slots.help: The GD-ROM image. A .gdi index (with its track files beside it), a .cdi, a .chd, or a .cue - and a naked .elf, which the HLE bios boots straight from memory the way homebrew is usually tested.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the machine's memory cards start with already on them. These are the files Emulator > Export Save Data... writes, put back under the same names - vmu_A1.bin through vmu_D1.bin, one card in the first slot of each connected controller. Each is mounted read-only and pinned by hash, and the movie cites it, so a movie that starts from a saved game is as reproducible as one that starts from a blank card. Leave it empty and the machine formats fresh cards.
